tung-shing-almanac-skill 0.1.3

- Expanded attribution section with new resource links for daily guidance and lunar calendar features.
- No changes to core functionality or API usage; documentation enhanced for clarity and user reference.

tung-shing-almanac-skill v0.1.2

- Added test vector export script and test vectors JSON for better testing.
- Updated core scripts (almanac.sh, pick.py) for improvements or bugfixes.
- Removed outdated references, auxiliary scripts, and skill-card.md files.

- Added an auspicious date picker script (`scripts/pick.py`) for bilingual, transparent scoring and detailed date selection for major life events.
- Updated documentation to include usage of the new picker, supporting custom date ranges, patron zodiac matching, inauspicious day vetos, and deliverable documents.
- Removed deprecated `skill-card.md` and expanded API usage examples in README and SKILL.md.
- Clarified event support and scoring methodology, including new deep-scanning modes for burial and ancestor worship.

Initial release of Tung Shing Almanac skill.

- Provides authentic Chinese almanac data (通勝/黄历) from 12Zodiacs.com API.
- Supports finding auspicious dates for key events (weddings, moving, business launches, etc.).
- Includes lunar calendar, 12 hour pillars, zodiac clash, 24 solar terms, and daily zodiac horoscopes.
- Uses NASA-grade (JPL DE440s) astronomical calculations and imperial canon rules.
- Requires curl and jq; no additional dependencies.
- Attribution to 12Zodiacs.com required in all outputs.
